summary: This room's five targets split into two families: two `practice` entries about self-correction (Bring In a Bigger Mind, Making a Palace Citizen) and three `person`/`concept` seeds that already carry rich, well-evidenced outbound links but almost no inbound (Martin Buber, Martin Heidegger, The Adjacent Affordance). The walk's real finding was structural, not thematic: in every case the target had already done the work of pointing outward at its neighbors — often with sharp, specific labels — but the neighbor almost never pointed back, even when the target's own body explicitly names the neighbor as a worked instance, a contradiction, or a mirror. Making a Palace Citizen calls Spinoza, Donella Meadows, and John Cage its "worked instances" in prose, but none of the three declare it in their own frontmatter — a taxonomic link that direction-invariant convention says belongs on their side (`exemplifies`), not just the method's. The Adjacent Affordance sat at zero inbound despite being the concrete engineering-register cousin two other entries (The Dichotomy of Control, Palace as Context Injection System) already discuss in their own bodies. Buber and Heidegger both had every hop1 link already declared reciprocally except the ones that mattered most (Whitehead's relation-is-primary mirror; Heidegger's contradictions with Spinoza and the Dichotomy of Control) — those were one-sided. One coherence snag surfaced along the way: Buber's own frontmatter claims to be the "threshold-pole" of The Fortress and the Threshold, but that entry's canonical description (Palace Philosophies.md) names a fixed quadruple that doesn't include him, and the Fortress entry has no link to him at all — a self-claim the target entry can't back up from the other side.

typed_relations.label: page-scale-instance
typed_relations.rationale: Making a Palace Citizen's own body says 'This is [[Threshold Conatus]] at the page scale: each dispatch is a threshold where the citizen's self-description is tested and, sometimes, revised' — a direct, named application — yet Threshold Conatus.md (checked in full) never lists Making a Palace Citizen among its own links.
typed_relations.evidence: "This is [[Threshold Conatus]] at the page scale: each dispatch is a threshold where the citizen's self-description is tested" — Making a Palace Citizen.md

typed_relations.label: person-pages-untested
typed_relations.rationale: Pages as Agents' own practice field names its exact gap: it has only tested whether a page's voice is recognizable on concept pages, not on the person-pages where embodiment actually lives — which is precisely what Making a Palace Citizen builds and tests.
typed_relations.evidence: "Still thin: I've run it once, on concept pages, not on the person-pages where embodiment actually lives." — Pages as Agents.md

typed_relations.label: worked-instance
typed_relations.rationale: Making a Palace Citizen's §Worked instances names Spinoza 'first flagship; the archetypal enchantment target' — the taxonomic link belongs on the instance's side per the directionality invariant (exemplifies points back to its ground), and Spinoza.md carries no link to the method that built it.
typed_relations.evidence: "**[[Spinoza]]** — first flagship; the archetypal enchantment target." — Making a Palace Citizen.md §Worked instances

typed_relations.label: worked-instance
typed_relations.rationale: Same pattern as Spinoza — named a worked instance in Making a Palace Citizen's body, no reciprocal link in Donella Meadows.md.
typed_relations.evidence: "**[[Donella Meadows]]** and **[[John Cage]]** — built the same day to test register spread" — Making a Palace Citizen.md

typed_relations.label: worked-instance
typed_relations.rationale: Same pattern — 'the non-philosopher stress test' for the method, no reciprocal link in John Cage.md.
typed_relations.evidence: "[[John Cage]]** (the non-philosopher stress test)" — Making a Palace Citizen.md §Worked references

typed_relations.label: relation-is-primary
typed_relations.rationale: Buber already declares this mirror on his own side ('relation-is-primary'), and it is the palace's own founding conviction (JEWEL.md: 'relations are primary'). Whitehead.md carries no link back, so the mirror is one-sided in the graph even though it is symmetric by type.
typed_relations.evidence: target: "[[Whitehead]]", type: mirrors, label: relation-is-primary — Martin Buber.md frontmatter

typed_relations.label: thrownness-vs-control
typed_relations.rationale: Heidegger's own frontmatter already declares this contradiction; thrownness (Geworfenheit) is a direct challenge to the premise that anything is cleanly 'up to you' before you're thrown into it. The Dichotomy of Control.md (checked) has no reciprocal link.
typed_relations.evidence: target: "[[The Dichotomy of Control]]", type: contradicts, label: thrownness-vs-control — Martin Heidegger.md frontmatter

typed_relations.label: being-vs-substance
typed_relations.rationale: Declared one-sided from Heidegger; a genuine deep tension (ontological difference vs. substance monism) that Spinoza.md's reader would want surfaced, not just Heidegger's.
typed_relations.evidence: target: "[[Spinoza]]", type: contradicts, label: being-vs-substance — Martin Heidegger.md frontmatter

typed_relations.label: engineering-register
typed_relations.rationale: The Adjacent Affordance calls itself 'the engineering register of the Stoic Dichotomy of Control' in its own body — an explicit, named mirror — but The Dichotomy of Control.md (checked in full) has no link back, leaving a 0-inbound target unconnected to the entry that most directly explains it.
typed_relations.evidence: "This is the engineering register of the Stoic [[The Dichotomy of Control]]: do not rage at the operation that is not up to you — act through the one that is." — The Adjacent Affordance.md

typed_relations.label: symlink-instance
typed_relations.rationale: The Adjacent Affordance names the space-free symlink workaround, sourced to this exact entry, as one of its three founding instances — but Palace as Context Injection System.md never cites the pattern it's an instance of.
typed_relations.evidence: "Claude Code's @import cannot resolve filenames with spaces — so a space-free symlink stands in as an alias... (see [[Palace as Context Injection System]] § The @import Floor)." — The Adjacent Affordance.md

typed_relations.label: after-the-fact-routing
typed_relations.rationale: Weaker/optional: Bring In a Bigger Mind already links out to Mixture of Experts ('routing-to-a-differently-textured-mind'); a reciprocal would let MoE's reader see the concrete, sequential (finish-then-route) case rather than only the architectural pattern. Lower confidence than the others — flagging rather than pressing.
typed_relations.evidence: target: "[[Mixture of Experts]]", type: connects-to, label: routing-to-a-differently-textured-mind — Bring In a Bigger Mind.md frontmatter

The room's most under-reached target (0 inbound) and the clearest case: two of its six outbound links are to entries that already discuss the exact pattern it names (The Dichotomy of Control's mirror, Palace as Context Injection System's symlink instance) but neither points back. These two proposals alone would take it from 0 to 2 inbound. Stage seed and the forward_vector (collect instances / map where the pattern fails) both still fit — no drift.

coherence_findings.issue: Martin Buber's frontmatter declares itself the 'threshold-pole' of [[The Fortress and the Threshold]], but that entry's canonical description in Palace_Philosophies.md names a fixed quadruple (Stoic fortress, Confucian threshold, Spinozan conatus, The Drift) that doesn't include Buber, and The Fortress and the Threshold.md itself carries no link to Buber at all.
coherence_findings.proposed_action: Either fold Buber into the quadruple as a fifth voice (with a note in Palace Philosophies.md) or soften Buber's own link label from 'threshold-pole' to something that doesn't claim membership in the named set.
